program_dir=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792545741/attempts/24c6b32aa5ef47bea0ad877ddcf721da/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
program_path=program_dir/'task-9eacc57a.py'
program_path.write_text('''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    horizontal = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1]
    vertical = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]

    def sections(length, dividers):
        cuts = [-1] + dividers + [length]
        return [(cuts[i] + 1, cuts[i + 1]) for i in range(len(cuts) - 1)]

    row_sections = sections(h, horizontal)
    col_sections = sections(w, vertical)
    interior = [grid[r][c] for r in range(h) if r not in horizontal
                for c in range(w) if c not in vertical]
    background = max(set(interior), key=interior.count)
    out = []
    for r0, r1 in row_sections:
        row = []
        for c0, c1 in col_sections:
            marks = sum(grid[r][c] != background for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1))
            row.append(1 if marks > 1 else background)
        out.append(row)
    return out
''')
exec(program_path.read_text(), globals())
